description:
Functional spec/files: inspect shared Jido.Chat adapter/authentication contract and define a versioned private host request type accepted by sink_mfa(payload, opts), response union, operation allowlist, immutable host context, request identity and deadlines. Separate bootstrap bind from bound document CRUD; preserve current opaque binding/profile derivation and runtime policy. Audit whether shared core needs extension; do not represent secret-bearing storage as public ActionEvent.
Tests before code: contract tests for absent records, successful committed writes, malformed/unknown requests, callback exceptions/timeouts, redacted inspect/logging, spoofed message/webhook storage requests, bootstrap without registered State. Branches: startup, restored connection, pairing document handoff, normal runtime, unsupported capability.
Action reuse: extend Jido.Chat adapter callback contract and existing package sink invocation; reuse Engine credential_document operations unchanged; internal RPC contract is local-only, not a new Action/tool. Inputs include op, opaque binding and encoded records; outputs preserve current union. Only trusted constructor grants host context, never incoming chat data. No data mutation in contract design.
Mocking: upstream host boundary only; use actual envelopes and serializers. Documentation: shared adapter docs, WhatsApp adapter_contracts, ZAQ services/channels and engine owners. Deliver approved protocol and ownership contract before implementation.

comments.text: Audit contract in both repositories; shared core only if required. Read parent epic Agent execution handoff before starting. Preserve existing reaction-normalization work.

Contract decision: package-private Storage.Request struct (redacted Inspect, version/id, opaque binding and existing document request). Synchronous sink RPC bounded at 7 seconds; Engine keeps 5s transaction/6s RPC. No shared Jido.Chat API or public ActionEvent extension required. Host runtime sink gets a captured reference on a separate arity; public chat ingress rejects storage structs. Existing Split document_mfa remains compatibility mode, sink wins without dual writes. Approved implementation scope comes from user start implementing.

Implemented private request contract with redacted Inspect and sanitized failures. Package contract/compatibility targeted tests passed: 1 property, 16 tests. Source compatibility retained via optional document_mfa. Contract is provider-private, so shared core does not change.
